title: BrowserStoppedData
description: data of browser.stopped (registry 1.7.0, ADR-0051): a browser session ended and tilo-browser dropped its context (BR-12). outcome says how (BR-07, BR-08, BR-10); steps counts proposals, refused ones included. A login wall also raises the FR-CON-08 needs-you card, and needs_person a needs-you card with the model's question as data. actor is the unit's agent, or the person for stopped and taken_over; authz null.
